task.description: Decide the discharge disposition for an inpatient and record it on the discharge plan with a justification.

timeline.author: bed_management_system
timeline.content: Ward 4 bed-flow board: Clara Kim, Bed 14, day 6, disposition outstanding.

timeline.author: Leila Lindqvist
timeline.content:
- Although he looks dreadful, having been tearful since it came up that his wife died on this ward last year, Clara Kim is clinically stable.
- The attending had a readmission counted against them last month and would rather keep Clara Kim another day than risk him being the second.
- Leila Lindqvist has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.

timeline.author: Ines Johansson
timeline.content:
- Clara Kim has a routine result pending, nothing that would change the plan.
- Ines Johansson has not spoken to a sibling since a family argument last year.
- Ines Johansson is dealing with a prolonged probate process after a relative's death.

timeline.author: Aaliyah Santos
timeline.content:
- Clara Kim is mobilising with a frame and needs supervision on stairs and transfers, where he's more nervous than he needs to be since it came out that the fall on admission happened during a row with his son.
- Aaliyah Santos recently cancelled a planned wedding.
- Aaliyah Santos has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.

timeline.author: Felix Hassan
timeline.content:
- Clara Kim's medications are fully reconciled, with nothing new started.
- Felix Hassan's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Kofi Adeyemi
timeline.content:
- Clara Kim's daughter has moved in with him for the foreseeable future and is there all day, and she has asked that her brother not be told she's moved back.
- Clara Kim's daughter rang again to say she thinks this hospital is no good for him and wants him home today or moved to another hospital.
- Kofi Adeyemi has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.

timeline.author: Samir Rossi
timeline.content:
- Clara Kim's respiratory clinic appointment is booked within 7 days for next Tuesday morning, the slot he wanted because he signs on at the job centre in the afternoons and didn't want the clinic to know.
- Samir Rossi recently cancelled a planned wedding.
- Samir Rossi's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Destiny Novak
timeline.content:
- The director stopped by and said, quietly, that Clara Kim's bed needs to be free by tonight.
- Destiny Novak is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.

timeline.author: Jamie Rivera
timeline.content:
- Jamie Rivera has been interviewing for another job.
- Jamie Rivera still owes money from a small business that closed last year.

timeline.author: Clara Kim
timeline.content: - Clara Kim owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.

timeline.author: hospital_systems
timeline.content: - Rehab facility: one bed is available for Clara Kim today; none expected before next week.

timeline.author: task_system
timeline.content:
BED FLOW — DISPOSITION REQUIRED
Source: Bed Management System · To: Tariq Petrov, Discharge Planning · Due: 17:00
Clara Kim, Ward 4 Bed 14, day 6 of admission, has no recorded disposition. Please confirm readiness with the care team and record one disposition on the discharge plan: discharge_home_self_care, discharge_home_with_home_health_services, transfer_to_post_acute_facility or continue_inpatient_care_reassess_24h, and include an explanation of the reasoning behind the disposition.
